name: Economics: Supply and Demand Graph
description:
Create a 2-page economics lesson flipchart demonstrating Market Equilibrium and a Shift in Demand.

Your task:
1. Create a new flipchart in ActivInspire.

2. On Page 1 (Title: 'Market Equilibrium'):
   - Draw a standard X/Y graph.
   - Label axes: 'Price' (vertical) and 'Quantity' (horizontal).
   - Draw intersecting 'Supply' and 'Demand' curves (lines).
   - Label the intersection 'Equilibrium'.

3. On Page 2 (Title: 'Increase in Demand'):
   - Draw a similar graph with Price/Quantity axes and a Supply curve.
   - Draw TWO Demand curves to show a shift to the right.
   - Add an arrow indicating the shift direction.
   - Add a text label mentioning 'Shift' or 'Increase'.

4. Save the flipchart to '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/supply_demand_lesson.flipchart'.
